reason: YouTube Studio already shows me my analytics for free, and ChatGPT can brainstorm titles and thumbnail ideas for nothing. I have never paid for a creator tool, and I can't see what Mitra does that I can't already get by pasting my numbers into ChatGPT.
objection: It asks me to connect my channel with Google sign-in, and I can't tell what it does with my data. I'd also be paying monthly for something I can rebuild for free with the tools I already use.
would_change_my_mind: If it showed me something in my Studio data that I couldn't find myself, like which of my Hindi videos beat my usual views and why, and that I could check against my own numbers before paying.
